{
  "verdict": "revise",
  "score": 0.42,
  "reasons": [
    "Artifact is not a complete, structured markdown file per the brief: it only includes an Executive Summary and partial 'Raw findings' content, with no full sections for each required element (pilot lines, production capacities, performance metrics with sources, manufacturing methods, costs, patents/IP disputes, analyst projections, blockers).",
    "There is no explicit, enumerated list of reported technical and supply-chain blockers; blockers appear only in a vague limitations note rather than a dedicated list.",
    "Claims lack per-claim citations and credibility notes. While URLs are present, there is no consistent attribution or short credibility assessment for each assertion.",
    "Content appears incomplete/truncated (the artifact is stated as truncated to 6000 characters) and thus omits many actors and data points requested (e.g., Toyota, Samsung, detailed pilot-line capacities, cost projections, detailed manufacturing methodologies).",
    "Missing the required data structure: a structured markdown file with sections such as Company status tables, pilot lines/capacities, performance metrics with sources, manufacturing methods, costs, IP, analyst projections, and blockers."
  ],
  "guidance": "Create a complete raw_findings.md that adheres to the instruction. Do the following: 
- Add an Executive Summary (concise, evidence-based). 
- For each target company (QuantumScape, Solid Power, ProLogium, CATL, Toyota, Samsung SDI, etc.), include: product/stage, announced dates, and current status.
- Include announced pilot lines and production capacities (quantities, line counts, or annualized throughput) with sources and credibility notes.
- List reported cell performance metrics (energy density, cycle life, safety incidents, operating temperature) with citations for each metric.
- Document announced manufacturing methods and materials (sulfide, oxide, polymer, composite) and any scale-up demonstrations, with sources.
- Include any cost or cost-projection figures available, with sources.
- Note notable patents or IP disputes reported, with sources.
- Incorporate analyst timeline projections and credible expectations (e.g., 2030–2035 targets) with sources.
- Provide an explicit, enumerated list of reported technical and supply-chain blockers (e.g., interface stability, dendrite formation, stack pressure, electrolyte manufacturing, material supply, yield, testing/qualification), with each item supported by sources and a short credibility note.
- Ensure every claim has a citation link and a short credibility note (e.g., primary source company PR, regulatory filing, or independent analyst report).
- Use up-to-date sources from the last ~5 years, prioritizing primary sources, then corroborating third-party coverage.
- Present content in clean markdown format with clear section headers and, where helpful, compact tables or bullet lists.
- Remove the current limitations note and ensure the file is self-contained and ready for other researchers to build on."
}
